body.heading: Where in the world is Equatorial Guinea?
paragraphs: Equatorial Guinea is a country in Middle Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Equatorial Guinea is Malabo.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Equatorial Guinea speak Spanish and French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Equatorial Guinea is the Central African CFA franc. The CFA franc is shared with neighbouring countries, so the same money works across the region.

body.heading: How big is Equatorial Guinea?
paragraphs: Equatorial Guinea covers about 28,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Togo.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Monte Alén protects thick rainforest in the mainland region of Río Muni — waterfalls, rivers and wildlife including gorillas, elephants and mandrills.
The capital Malabo sits on Bioko island beneath Pico Basile, a volcano you can drive up for views across the sea to Cameroon on a clear day.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Equatorial Guinea on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
